title: Dr. H.M.S. Kumar NDE 850
content:
During a school holiday, my class teacher asked me to make an electric call bell using just a steel cup, nail and a copper wire with armature. I designed and prepared one, which I tested several times, to ensure if it functioned or not because I had to take this device to my school next day for a small exhibition arranged there. At around 3:30 pm I was alone in my room in a big farmhouse. My father and mother were in the back yard and doing some work. I wanted to try my call bell. I accidentally caught a live electric wire while experimenting on this prototype of a self-made call-bell. As the cable was too long, the voltage was 220V, and since I was holding the live wire in both hands, I suffered from electric shock for a sufficiently long time. Initially, I experienced a great pain and all that any shock victim would experience. As no one was there to rescue me for some time, slowly my pain ceased and I started raising from my body and started to float above. I could see the letters written on the roof tiles from very near, almost a few inches. Each letter appeared very big to me. It was a wonderful, painless state and very cool and yet full of emotions. I had perfect crystal clear consciousness. I could see my body lying on the floor head down and still holding the wire. I rose to about ten feet off the ground and I stopped hovering near the roof tiles. I was calling for help but no one was there. After some time I noticed my dad coming from the other end of the house, I could see him through the walls, and he was coming very slowly as he was not aware of the accident. I tried to call my dad very loud but he could not hear me even though he arrived near. He was chewing tobacco and murmuring something then (it was his habit). It was like as if I was in a dream. But naturally when he reached the spot, he saw me (my body) lying on the ground. Without knowing that I am holding the live wire, he held me tight and tried to lift me up. Suddenly I experienced a great pain and I fell back into my body. I went into an unconscious state for at least ten minutes later and when I woke up my dad and mom were sitting near me. First word I uttered after seeing them was, 'Mom I experienced today how one dies,' but my parents were horrified. They took me to a doctor to explain to him that I might have gone insane due to electric shock. Whenever I started talking about my experience, they discouraged me and avoided the conversation, thinking that it may adversely affect my studies. Later my mom told me that she came and rescued both me and my dad by switching off the mains; but I never saw her coming to rescue me as I could only see my dad.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Electric shock while holding a live 220V wire during a self-made call-bell experiment.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Observed father approaching and could see through walls; attempted to call for help but was not heard; pain on re-entry and subsequent unconsciousness.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred without tunnel/light/otherworldly realm; return occurred when father grabbed the body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived letters on roof tiles from inches away; could see father approaching through walls; did not see mother rescue them though she later reported switching off the mains.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Mom I experienced today how one dies,”
